name: basic-parser-studio
description: BASIC Language Parser Studio using Flex and GNU Bison in Yacc-compatible mode

scripts.build:backend: cd parser && (gcc -Wall -Wextra -std=c11 -O2 -o basic_parser main.c ast.c parser.tab.c lex.yy.c || make all) && cd ../backend && npm install
scripts.build:frontend: cd frontend && npm install && npm run build
